When no one sees the work

A short read for tired grown-ups and little listeners—pairs with When Parenting Feels Overwhelming and Invisible.

Read-aloud

Ruth worked hard in the fields. Boaz noticed her faithfulness and spoke a blessing over her. God sees quiet faithfulness too—dishes, homework help, late-night prayers, and small kindnesses no one applauds.

The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust. Ruth 2:12 (KJV)

Little ones can hear: God sees the work even when the room is messy and nobody said thank you yet.

Gentle question

What is one quiet good thing someone did for you today—or one you did for someone else?

Short prayer together

Lord, thank You for seeing quiet work. Help us trust under Your wings. Amen.

Coloring idea

Wheat fields, gentle wings, or Ruth gathering grain. Color & Tell → Ruth and Naomi · Verse Image → morning hope (T24).
